name: pm-guidelines
description: Cross-project PM best practices enforcement — 736 guidelines, 14 skills, 2 slash commands, 7 agents, 8 hooks (7 quality checks in single dispatcher). Covers status labels, bilingual parity, dashboard quality, cross-tab reconciliation, link integrity, context-boundary scrub, MD/HTML parity, data-readiness gate, DevOps integration, HTML infrastructure, modal accessibility, print CSS, title consistency, session discipline, estimation, consolidation, and standalone updates. v1.8.0 adds the lesson-refinement workflow toolchain — the /pm-guidelines:PM-lessons-audit slash command (deterministic structural audit of global_lessons.md), the pm-lessons-content-duplicates agent (semantic dupe detector), and the /pm-guidelines:PM-lessons-refine orchestrator (chains audit + decision sheet + renumber + merge + verify + PR). Also includes the lesson-gap-analyzer deterministic-primitives fix from PR #1 and Rule 38-bis (reflog-aware mid-session verification) added to pm-session-discipline.
